question: The value of (17 - 9) + (57 - 10 ÷ 5 of 2) ÷ 4 is:
solution:
**Given:**

(17 - 9) + (57 - 10 ÷ 5 of 2) ÷ 4

**Concept used:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/694d0d67bc14effd3a3679b70b4d77edef851107a6a53b64ea488e47e4c2bef5.png] **

**Calculation:**

(17 - 9) + (57 - 10 ÷ 5 of 2) ÷ 4

⇒ 8 + (57 - 10 ÷ 10) ÷ 4

⇒ 8 + (57 - 1) ÷ 4

⇒ 8 + 56 ÷ 4

⇒ 8 + 14

⇒ 22

**∴ Required answer is 22.**
